squad_seats_index_in_row.name: squad_seats_index_in_row
squad_seats_index_in_row.value:
("squad_seats"."row" = 'front'  AND "squad_seats"."index" BETWEEN 0 AND 1)
       OR ("squad_seats"."row" = 'middle' AND "squad_seats"."index" BETWEEN 0 AND 2)
       OR ("squad_seats"."row" = 'back'   AND "squad_seats"."index" = 0)

squads_kind_shape.name: squads_kind_shape
squads_kind_shape.value:
("squads"."kind" = 'defense' AND "squads"."zone" IS NOT NULL AND "squads"."slot_index" IS NULL)
       OR ("squads"."kind" = 'offense' AND "squads"."zone" IS NULL AND "squads"."slot_index" BETWEEN 0 AND 2)

battle_records_cleanup_idx.name: battle_records_cleanup_idx
battle_records_cleanup_idx.where: "battle_records"."replay_blob_url" is not null and "battle_records"."replay_deleted_at" is null
